question: Who presided over the first Lucknow Session of Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Romesh Chunder Dutt.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **15th Session of Congress** was headed by **Ramesh Chunder Dutt.**
 
• It was held in** Lucknow **in **1899.**
 
• In this session, the demand was raised for the permanent fixation of land revenue.
 
• There was a total of **3 sessions** of Congress held in Lucknow.**​**__
 
• **Congress Session in Lucknow**

• The **Indian National Congress** was founded by** AO Hume** on **28th December 1885.**
 
• Before independence, **54 sessions of Congress** were held in India.
 
• The **first session** was held in ** Bombay **in the year **1885**.
 
 
• **President: **WC Banerjee
 
 
 
• The** last session** of Congress was held in **Meerut** in the year **1946**.
